metric_scope: Primary wall is outer encode/selection start through durable ACK. Selector target rows include any lazy seed; forced-schema target rows exclude its separately reported upfront seed. Setup-inclusive session totals charge both symmetrically. CPU is outer sender plus disjoint receiver handlers. Phase sums are supplementary; target-phase exchange excludes optional seed but includes remote work/waiting, not pure wire time. Body bytes exclude transport headers/relay hops.
